name: 45458 · Centerville, OH
findings: ZIP 45458 (Centerville) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 55 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 45458 (Centerville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
